label: World Liberty Financial freezes 27.8M USD1 after Binance hack
note: At Ethereum block 26301299 (2026-10-29 22:10:35 UTC), the USD1 multisig froze address 0x5227f603C1eE34CE3C06eFe6477003BDfCCB2f8c holding 27,824,039.94 USD1 linked to the October 29 Binance hack. World Liberty Financial CEO Zach Witkoff publicly confirmed the proactive freeze.
